# Six v0.3.1 - Table of Contents

Zero-dependency Elixir coverage tool built for AI-assisted development

## Modules

- [Six](https://six.hexdocs.pm/Six.md): Zero-dependency Elixir coverage tool built for AI-assisted development.
- [Six.Formatter](https://six.hexdocs.pm/Six.Formatter.md): Behaviour for Six coverage output formatters.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix six](https://six.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Six.md): Runs `mix test --cover` with Six as the coverage tool.
- [mix six.detail](https://six.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Six.Detail.md): Same as `mix six` but includes source-level annotation output.
- [mix six.html](https://six.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Six.Html.md): Generates an HTML coverage report at `.six/coverage.html`.
